headline: USTR leaves resolution on tariffs on Mexico over structural excess capacity pending
summary: The US Trade Representative has not yet issued a resolution on tariffs for Mexico over alleged structural overcapacity. The decision remains outstanding.
why: The USTR handles US trade policy and tariff investigations, and Mexico is one of the largest US trading partners. Pending decisions affect trade-exposed Mexican exporters and the peso.
original_headline: La USTR deja pendiente resolución sobre aranceles a México por exceso de capacidad estructural
